supervisor.hashMode: RAW_BYTES; source authored as LF; a CRLF-rewritten checkout refuses, with no normalization into acceptance

toolchain.versionClaim: Pinned filename: Node 20.19.0; no new runtime version qualification
toolchain.packageAndLockIdentity: bound source blobs, reused installed dependencies; not clean-install proof
toolchain.memoryBounds: Node old-space limits bound the V8 heap only. The G0 host floor of 1536 MiB is available capacity. Every G0 supervised subject Job Object has a 512 MiB committed-memory cap and separately reported PeakJobMemoryUsed; helper/supervisor/compiler processes outside the measured subject Job are separately accounted and uncapped. Enforcement/measurement: NOT_RUN; no aggregate owned-memory cap claim.

windowsHelper.type: embedded PowerShell/C# Job Object helper compiled with installed Add-Type only in the future approved run
windowsHelper.bootstrap: No-compiler in-process Reflection.Emit P/Invoke before Add-Type; helper self-assigned to the outer kill-on-close/process-limited Job Object before compiler descendants can start. 64-bit EXTENDED_LIMIT layout: 144 bytes; all other layouts refuse. No breakaway.
windowsHelper.normalCleanup: Inner subject Job active count zero and complete/drained start-event count; outer Job active count 1 (helper only) after compilation and after subject cleanup. The helper handle stays alive until process exit. A missing receipt or an outer-kill, compilation, error or I/O-failure receipt keeps the reservation HELD.
windowsHelper.memory: G0: EACH inner subject Job Object has a 512 MiB committed-memory limit, including its Node/Vitest/test/esbuild descendants; native limit readback and a PeakJobMemoryUsed receipt are required. The Node supervisor/PowerShell helper/Add-Type compiler belong outside the measured subject Job and are separately accounted/uncapped. Process/bootstrap/wall/handle holds remain. NOT_RUN.

executionPolicy.bypass: NOT_ENABLED; any process bypass needs separate explicit approval
executionPolicy.projection: WINDOWS_POLICY_CONTEXT_V1: uppercase PATH (with pinned Node prefix), SYSTEMROOT, WINDIR, COMSPEC, USERPROFILE, HOMEDRIVE, HOMEPATH, LOCALAPPDATA, APPDATA. Commands may override only NODE_ENV/NODE_OPTIONS; policy override variables are refused.
executionPolicy.record: A separate opening observation carries all five ordered scopes, Process=Undefined, effective precedence and exact helper/PowerShell/environment/window/run bindings. Freshness is bounded only at opening. The earlier coordinator/reviewer comparison binds the contract, not these future observation bytes.
executionPolicy.separateAuthority: A committed actual HUMAN_USER observation-authority record declares action, manifest, window, run, finite notBefore/notAfter and maximumObservations=1. Current code checks these fields, not an observation digest in that authority. The actual observation digest is retained separately; global one-shot enforcement is not implemented. No bypass or policy change.

windowsHelper.inheritedHandles: HELD exact STARTUPINFOEX allowlist; no execution until reviewed correction
windowsHelper.compilation: Only CS0649 is suppressed around interop structs. Add-Type: NOT_RUN, with future separate approval required; compiler process fit is unproved.

versionMetadata.claim: Package file metadata only; not runtime qualification

dependencyTree.encoding: UTF8(JSON.stringify(rows)) with no BOM, no newline and no whitespace
dependencyTree.ordering: Buffer.compare(Buffer.from(path,"utf8"),Buffer.from(path,"utf8")); increasing unsigned UTF8 bytes, with forward-slash logical relative paths
dependencyTree.symlinkPolicy: Dereference only targets contained in the exact disclosed root; reject escapes, nonregular entries and cycles; retain the logical relative path for private-copy comparison
dependencyTree.metadataObservation: File bytes read/hash only, with no imports or subject execution. The same digest is required pre-copy, post-copy and per command; no installed-tree immutability or runtime performance/capacity claim.
dependencyTree.futureRetention: Future separately authorized preparation must retain the exact sorted {path,bytes,sha256} row inventory plus raw hash, count, total bytes and digest. Existing totals/digest are producer metadata only; the original reviewer cannot recompute them from this packet. No new dependency walk or qualification now.

git.contract: Direct Git reader with pinned raw bytes, outside the subject-writable snapshot, using -C and GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1; hooks/fsmonitor/system/global config off; trusted repository/frozen inventory only, with no uncompared subject git status or filters outside the Job. Metadata Git is outside the subject Job; timeout/runtime/system DLL limits are disclosed.
git.runtimePinLimit: The direct mingw64 Git reader raw hash is enforced. These 84 bin-DLL hashes are descriptive retained source metadata, not enforced runtime loaded-module pins. Actual loaded/system DLLs and metadata Git descendant termination remain unqualified; no hermetic or whole-toolchain containment claim.

snapshot.name: <directly-approved-runId>/snapshot
snapshot.cwd: absolute snapshot root for every command
snapshot.objects: read-only local source object database via Git alternates; no remote fetch
snapshot.nodeModules: owned private dereferenced copy of existing disclosed real path; no junction/no npm install/ci
snapshot.dist: <snapshot>/dist; script/build.mjs deletes only this unique owned snapshot output
snapshot.viteCache: Real Vite is not admitted. Future G8 needs an owned cacheDir and disclosure of both 0.0.0.0 listeners; no write to shared node_modules/.vite.
snapshot.cleanup: Preserve unique receipts and owned snapshot. No automatic recursive deletion. Only exact run-owned Job Object descendants may be terminated.
snapshot.evidenceRetention: Host Temp is externally purgeable. No automatic cleanup. Fsynced records are atomically published without replacement; pending links are not completion markers. Durable external retention/copy requires separate scope.
snapshot.inputTrust: Tracked inventory comes from the trusted manifest source repository or the preparation-frozen raw inventory; GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1. Snapshot .git, replace objects, filters and status are not source identity authorities. Per-command fixtures, critical hashes and complete path/metadata checks remain; full dependency bytes are inventoried before and after a group.

preparation.entrypoint: Explicit --prepare with --manifest, --window, --approval-verification, --window-review, --policy-observation, --pre-window-observation, --reservation and --admission. Policy observation is loaded and raw-hashed at opening; owner/coordinator/reviewer comparison binds the contract rather than later bytes or a specific observation-authority record. That authority is checked separately at opening. Source/hold checks remain.
actions: one maximum-floor host observation before window start
unique private local Git snapshot and dependency copy
frozen G1 scratch/config files inside unique snapshot
Windows Add-Type compilation only during supervised children
requiresExplicitApproval: Actual coordinator-verified human decision for exact supervisor/manifest/f581/groups/actions/limits/window
Future verified effective-policy fact for exact helper route without bypass
preparation.allSetupAdmissionHashAndReceiptTimeCharg: From authority-check start through completion. Preparation/group ceilings and approvedAt + 140 minutes are absolute and capped by window expiry.
preparation.deadline: At most 15 minutes inside the approved four-hour window and the 140-minute aggregate. One separately authorized maximum-floor admission is required. Cancellable file streams and local Git operations share the deadline; preserve a partial owned root without retry or removal.
preparation.admission: Exact PREPARE reservation and raw authority digests, one fresh separately authorized maximum opened-group floor observation, and 20 GiB disk. No automatic probe. All work is charged to preparation and aggregate ceilings.
rawReceiptBindings: Exact manifest, supervisor executable, raw approval text, window, coordinator verification, window review and source disposition
preparation.evidenceDirectoryContract: PREPARE initializes the owned receipts directory once and binds receiptsDirectory=receipts plus initialEvidenceState=OWNED_EMPTY_DIRECTORY_INITIALIZED_BY_PREPARATION. Group loading requires that same existing directory and never recreates lost evidence.

bounds.resourceRefusalFurtherCheck: requires a recorded material change and remaining separately applicable authority
bounds.streamPolicy: Abort on the cap; retain the first capped raw bytes and observed counts. The application root test itself retains only 16 KiB child tails, not complete child logs.
bounds.aggregate: The absolute minimum of window expiry and approvedAt + 8,400,000 ms includes preparation, idle time, independent G0 acceptance, admission, inventories, commands, cleanup and receipts. No aggregate reset.
bounds.processCeilings: Exact G0 mapping: three for parser-self-test, exit-zero, exit-one, deadline-kill, stdout-cap, stderr-cap and refusal-path; four for real-child-tree; eight for vitest-baseline. Count the complete applicable owned tree including console hosts. Compilation is separately counted and HELD; no compiler ceiling is selected. Native topology, console-host attribution and cold-bootstrap proof remain prerequisites. 60,000 ms starts at the first Node-observed successful PowerShell helper spawn. Before launch, some dependency reads and the first handshake are bounded only by the unchanged 140-minute aggregate/window. No end-to-end one-minute or two-minute G0 bound is asserted. Host wall-clock continuity is trusted; backward steps remain a disclosed limitation.
bounds.attemptVsGroup: Every requested invocation has an immutable witness, distinct from a charged admission attempt. Published admission attempts still count under nine. A prospective group identity and completed in-process prefix survive clean zero-launch reentry; its execution wall starts once at the first successful helper child spawn. Once started, its witnessed clock/attempt cannot reset. Every prelaunch check/refusal/reentry uses real original outer time. No automatic retry or repeated control.

basis.contract: Resource refusal must not consume a group; count attempts separately, cap nine.

After first actual child spawn, retain the same group attempt, completed receipts and launch-bound group deadline. Requested/prelaunch timestamps do not establish that clock; clean zero-launch reentry remains within unchanged aggregate/window and invocation limits.

accountingProposal.groupAttempts: At most one child-execution group attempt per selected G0-G7 group; later child launches and resumptions retain it.
accountingProposal.admissionCharge: One charge for each explicit group invocation whose admission attempt record is published, including resume/refusal. Per-command admission handshakes inside that invocation are not additional invocation charges.
accountingProposal.nonCharged: Preparation remains its own one-shot bounded mode. Static/authority/source/dependency/owned-lock or marker refusal before an invocation attempt record uses no admission attempt. Refused resume before its attempt record preserves the valid immutable pause. A zero-child refusal does not consume the unstarted group; any published invocation attempt still counts under the unchanged nine cap.
accountingProposal.pauseConsequences: Only non-G0 started groups with proven cleanup, sufficient full resumed time, positive wait capacity, finite latestResumeStartAt and a future invocation that fits the unchanged nine cap may publish a pause. G0 remains terminal after launch. A last-child timeout may exhaust all remaining wait capacity and is then terminal, explicitly. No extra wait or attempt is invented.
accountingProposal.policyBoundary: This is a conservative source implementation proposal, not a new owner counting decision. The original reviewer and fresh actual decision must bind it; no alternate pending accounting policy is selected.
accountingProposal.terminalGroupRule: A terminal group result stops the remaining run, including groups that would otherwise be independent. This conservative stop rule preserves all failed/uncertain evidence and refuses later groups. No fresh invocation or marker loss bypasses it; no new approval or restart of the window is implied.
accountingProposal.zeroLaunch: Every clean zero-launch, unconsumed refusal with proven cleanup may bind a later explicit material-change-qualified invocation, whether its original error is coded or uncoded. Preserve the prospective attempt identity and raw completed in-process prefix; no group wall exists until the first successful child spawn. Actual aggregate/window, invocation and handshake allowance exhaustion still prevent execution. Uncertainty, actual consumption and genuine fixture failure remain sticky.
accountingProposal.clockInvariant: The requested/prelaunch clock is not a started-group deadline. Only first actual helper spawn begins the unchanged group wall. All started-group resumes retain its raw launch-clock witness/deadline. Original approval window and aggregate are never reset, extended or refunded.

windowBudgetProposal.notes: The unchanged 140-minute aggregate includes all preparation, prelaunch checks/controls/refusals, started-group work, actual G0 review and transitions. The existing nine-minute transition/idle allocation now explicitly includes nominal first-invocation prelaunch setup/parser/first-wait costs; it is not extra permission. All times remain proposed and unmeasured. A started group obtains only its unchanged wall at first actual child spawn, within the same absolute outer deadline.

initialPrelaunchSubdivision.reentry: Extra refused/reentry invocations spend actual remaining outer time and applicable existing invocation/wait allowance. Worst-case complete-plan retry fit is not promised; actual under-run or smaller proposal may be required.
initialPrelaunchSubdivision.disclosure: Fields retaining Ceiling in their historical names are planning arithmetic. Some dependency reads and the first handshake are bounded only by the aggregate. They do not prove an invocation-wide ceiling below the aggregate.

admission.heavyJobPredicate: Any non-owned Node/Vitest/tsx/tsc/build/test/server process, esbuild service, active Chromium browser context, Docker build/container/verifier workload or equivalent heavy compiler; Codex/OS hosts are excluded only by exact owner/start identity. Unclassifiable candidate means refusal. Docker Desktop idle presence alone is not an active workload; no cgroup memory claim.
admission.observations: One separately authorized maximum-floor observation before the window, one group admission, and a fresh bounded request/response before every child command. The supervisor never samples or frees capacity.
admission.floors: Available host memory: G0/G1/G2/G3/G4 1,536 MiB; G6 2,048 MiB; G5/G7 4,096 MiB. Disk floor: 20 GiB. Only G0 subject Jobs are capped at 512 MiB committed memory. Supervisor, helper and compiler are separately accounted outside those Jobs.
admission.order: Admit by ascending available-memory floor where dependencies allow: G0, G1, G2, G3, G4, then G5 before G6, then G7. G6 cannot run before its G5 dependency despite the lower floor. No admission authority exists now.
admission.preG7: A fresh attestation must establish that no process has open files under the exact owned snapshot dist. Missing evidence refuses the build.
admission.admissionRecord: manifestSha256,windowSha256,runId,group,commandId,requestNonce,requestSha256,reservationId,exclusive,leaseId,observedAt>=request,availableMiB,freeDiskGiB,noCompetingHeavyJob,heavyJobPredicate,inputsUnchanged,permissionsEstablished;G7ownedDistNoOpenHandles; availableMiB/freeDiskGiB are finite nonnegative numeric values; observationAuthorityReference is a nonempty string per root runtime; origin verification remains the coordinator/original reviewer duty
admission.reservationRecord: EXCLUSIVE_ACTIVE with exact runId, group, reservation id, lease and manifest digest. Uncertain owned-process or Job cleanup keeps the reservation held; a kill or timeout request is not absence proof.

handshake.mechanism: Atomically published nonce/raw-hash request and one separately authorized responder observation. No source assignment supplies that responder, resource sampling or polling loop. Before first launch, finite waits use original outer time; after launch they additionally use the witnessed group deadline.
handshake.publication: Write a unique pending response, fsync it, then atomically publish without replacing the exact requested basename. A partial/transient JSON read may await the next notification within the original wait deadline; no automatic retry or sampling loop.
handshake.continuation: A clean zero-launch refusal is an unconsumed requested group with no started wall, whether coded or ordinary. Raw refusal-bound material change can restore and skip its completed in-process prefix under actual finite outer/cap/wait limits. A started group preserves its launch-bound wall and may pause only under the full time/cap/latest-start test. G0 and exhausted last-child waits are terminal.
handshake.groupBudget: Every group slices its unchanged remaining handshakeWaitBudgetMs across remaining children. Prelaunch waits spend actual outer time; post-launch waits additionally obey the witnessed group deadline. Positive remaining capacity and future invocation/time/latest-start fit are required for any pause. G0 still shares 3,000 ms among seven handshakes.

responderEligibility.required: Before an execution proposal, name the actual separately permitted responder, exact observation authority and retained measured response-fit evidence against these slices. No probe, responder daemon or wait-budget increase is authorized here.

preWindow.authority: Separate actual one-shot HOST_PRE_WINDOW_OBSERVATION decision and committed coordinator authority, maximumObservations: 1, with notBefore/notAfter bounds. No observation grant is inferred.
preWindow.timing: approvedAt - 30,000 ms <= observedAt <= approvedAt. Decision, verification and original comparison may precede the window; host observation bytes remain separate from immutable window/review records.

focusedGreen.rule: For G2–G5, exact bound file/fullName multisets, per-file counts and final/supplemental suite totals must match; zero skipped/todo; every nonpredicted assertion passes and failures equal the exact 21 file/name/count/cause contracts. Any hook/unhandled/cleanup/unparsed/extra/missing/error mismatch stops. Raw exit 1/FAILED is retained; no expected-pass relabel, skip, in-run patch or automatic green.

doc52ReporterContract.jsonReporter: Vitest 4.1.10 JsonReporter: fullName joins ancestors/title with a space; assertion location/status/failureMessages; file message/status; final num* totals/success
doc52ReporterContract.supplementalReporter: File/nested-suite/errors/unhandled/totals evidence is mandatory; supplemental assertion IDs/modes/states/errors/location are retained only, not independently reconciled with JSON rows. Assertion identity uses the exact file/fullName/ancestorTitles/title multiset.
doc52ReporterContract.renderingRule: Pinned Vitest 4.1.10: %s uses raw String(value), preserving actual U+000A/U+000D; $key uses objDisplay, escaping control characters, then applying 37-character + ellipsis truncation and quotes. JSON encoding escapes real LF/CR bytes while decoded names retain them. Five G3 notification rows are corrected in both group/static inventories; no source/test change or execution.

approvalTrust.required: The coordinator retrieves Samuel's actual verbatim direct decision with trusted thread/message/question-answer origin and time, compares the exact proposal and commits the window and verification. The original reviewer independently compares the committed window, actual decision and applicable source disposition before preparation or G0. Files, flags and agent text alone are not consent.
approvalTrust.decision: Immutable threadId/messageId, exact decision text/SHA256, raw verification/window digests bound in preparation/group/command receipts.
approvalTrust.scope: Exact supervisor commit, tree and raw hash; raw manifest hash; qualified f581 source, tree and snapshots; groups, commands, preparation/compiler actions, overhead and G0 review budgets; resource, process, time and attempt bounds; immutable window.
approvalTrust.limitation: Trusted local operator record integrity only. Hashes, branch ancestry and record text do not authenticate human consent or withstand a privileged operator rewriting every input. Actual consent verification and independent comparison remain external duties. No execution approval exists now.

windowReview.fileContains: R3 raw JSON committed reference {repository,expectedBranch,commit,path,sha256} pointing to original reviewer R2 window comparison; not self-attestation.

requiredReviewerValue.sourceDisposition: Exact committed original reviewer source disposition reference

sourceDispositionRequired.eligibleModes: R1 eligibleModes must include the requested mode and every proposed window group. Source and command holds refuse independently.

windowReview.approvalTextChecks: Verbatim actual decision equals window.approvalText; exact source/tree, raw supervisor/manifest, action/group, finite window and run identity tokens. Only an approved preparation window may include exactly action=PREPARE; unrequired action tokens refuse. Coordinator and original reviewer independently compare semantic scope, human provenance and all limits. Literal/file/template presence is not consent.
windowReview.noG0Circularity: Accepted exact source and the reviewed actual execution window precede preparation/G0. Only dependent groups require the actual G0 receipt and accepting review. Native prerequisite vehicles need their own non-G0 authority; an earlier G0 receipt cannot be their prerequisite.

approvalTrust.receiptAuthorityBindings: Future receipts bind retained digests and committed references. Requested/invocation/actual-launch clock witnesses are separate immutable records. Opening policy bytes are fixed by their recorded digest from PREPARE onward; this source does not copy raw observation files into receipts or enforce global single-use.
approvalTrust.committedRecordChecks: Require an exact commit object and ancestry against the configured role branch, with the reference expectedBranch matching. Shared Git object storage proves neither authorship, human consent nor remote publication.
approvalTrust.decisionLiterals: The actual verbatim decision must contain exactly one whitespace-delimited token for each required label: manifestSha256, sourceCommit, sourceTree, supervisorSha256, runId, maximumAttempts, approvedAt and expiresAt, in label=value form. It must contain one group=<ID> token per authorized group, with no duplicate, range or suffix. Include action=PREPARE only when snapshot preparation is authorized. Exact tokens and ordered scope comparisons preserve record integrity; the coordinator and original reviewer still verify the actual human words and provenance.
approvalTrust.recordByteRules: R1-R4 are draft, unapproved templates. Publish exact UTF-8 Git blob bytes; caller files must match those committed raw bytes and hashes. Do not normalize or reserialize acceptance records. Preserve exact key order for decisionReference and scope; no record hashes itself or its containing commit.
approvalTrust.recordTiming: Actual decision.at <= coordinator verifiedAt <= original reviewer reviewedAt <= window approvedAt < expiresAt. Comparison timing remains independent of later opening policy bytes. Policy freshness is finite at opening; maximumObservations=1 is declared but single-use consumption is not enforced. Actual G0 receipt review remains inside its existing allowance and original aggregate/window; no extension.

recordTemplates.proposedWindowExclusions: No verification, opening-policy or reviewer hashes/references inside the immutable window. Later comparisons bind its raw hash and the observation contract. Policy/host observations are separate raw-hashed inputs with separately checked authority; policy maximumObservations=1 is a declaration without consumption enforcement. No self-containing hash cycle.
recordTemplates.coordinatorVerificationExclusions: executionPolicy is forbidden: no opening observation rows, paths, digest or observedAt may be included in the coordinator approval verification. The separate observation record/authority is validated and raw-bound at opening.

policyObservationContract.effectiveSelection: First non-Undefined row in that exact precedence order.
policyObservationContract.allUndefined: REFUSE; no implicit operating-system default is accepted.
policyObservationContract.freshness: Separate opening observation satisfies observedAt <= approvedAt and approvedAt - observedAt <= maximumAgeMs. It is outside the coordinator/reviewer verification chain, whose preparation may take longer. No observation or policy change is authorized by source authoring.
policyObservationContract.limitation: Historical opening observation only; no human authentication, continuous policy guarantee, raw-file custody or global one-shot enforcement is claimed. Actual separate observation permission remains required.
policyObservationContract.bindings: Loaded opening bytes are checked against the pinned PowerShell/helper/environment, manifest/window/run and ordered scope values. Their raw digest joins preparation/continuation authority; the separately loaded authority covers action, manifest/window/run and time bounds, without its own observation digest. Coordinator/reviewer scope compares the contract rather than future actual bytes.
policyObservationContract.processReason: The helper environment excludes PSExecutionPolicyPreference and supplies no -ExecutionPolicy override. Its Process scope is Undefined; an observation relying on a Process policy cannot establish its effective route.
policyObservationContract.oneShotLimit: maximumObservations=1 is a declared checked field, not a global consumption ledger. Opening byte identity is fixed only from PREPARE and retained in later stable authority. Trusted local operator origin/retention duties remain external; this task supplies no actual observation or stronger single-use proof.

decisionTokenContract.boundary: The whole token must match. Prefixes, hyphenated run-id suffixes and group ranges cannot satisfy a required token.
decisionTokenContract.extraActionTokens: REFUSE any action= token when preparation is not authorized; with preparation, exactly one action=PREPARE and no other action token.

executionPrerequisites.reason: Historical hold ID retained. Samuel selected the exact 3/4/8 stage map; this source implements it. Original successor acceptance and complete owned-tree/console-host evidence remain outstanding. Compiler phase remains separately HELD.

liftRoute.sourceChange: Original bounded review of this exact U15/D68 successor, followed by separately authorized standalone topology/bootstrap source and proof; no runtime override.
liftRoute.boundedFutureAction: The referenced dependency record identifies a missing standalone action contract and source/proof prerequisites. No current executable vehicle or argv is provided by this correction.
liftRoute.ordering: Exact G0 mapping: three for parser-self-test, exit-zero, exit-one, deadline-kill, stdout-cap, stderr-cap and refusal-path; four for real-child-tree; eight for vitest-baseline. Count the complete applicable owned tree including console hosts. Compilation is separately counted and HELD; no compiler ceiling is selected. Native topology, console-host attribution and cold-bootstrap proof remain prerequisites.
liftRoute.requiredReceipt: Exact accepted standalone topology fixture and actual raw full-tree count/identity/cleanup receipt, including console hosts and separately counted compiler phase. Source-only selection supplies no observation.
liftRoute.originalReviewerDisposition: Original reviewer accepts the exact vehicle source and eligible action first, then separately accepts its actual retained receipt. A source disposition is not an executed result or reservation.
liftRoute.executionAuthority: No execution authority exists. Standalone prerequisite actions require a distinct accepted authority/fixture contract and each actual one-shot owner decision, coordinator comparison, original window comparison and later receipt disposition.
